# GeoIP fixtures

These tiny databases contain dummy test data, not production geolocation data.
Copied from the MaxMind-DB repository's `test-data/` directory:
https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/test-data

Files: GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb and GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb.
The source project provides Apache-2.0 and MIT license texts alongside these files.
No real GeoIP.conf, account ID or license key is included.
